challenges.heading: Salt air near downtown and the beach
challenges.body: Homes near downtown Delray Beach and the coast sit in steady salt air, which corrodes the lugs, bus bars, and terminations inside a panel over time. A corroded connection runs hot, so on a coastal call we look at every connection before pricing the work.

challenges.heading: A century of construction under one roofline
challenges.body: Delray Beach ranges from early 20th century cottages near downtown to newer homes out west, so fuse boxes, early breaker panels, and modern equipment all turn up. Each era has its own quirks, and our crew knows what to expect before the cover comes off.

challenges.heading: Pools across older and newer neighborhoods

faqs.answer: That is common in the older neighborhoods close to downtown and the coast. Usually the fix is a modern, code-compliant panel that passes inspection, and we pull the permit and meet the inspector so the objection gets cleared.
